abstract: An antiserum was raised against glycoproteins isolated from teratocarcinoma OTT6050 by affinity chromatography on Ricinus communis agglutinin-1 (RCA-1). The antiserum inhibited attachment and spreading of the teratocarcinoma cells on plastic tissue culture plates. Embryonal carcinoma cells (F9 and N4-1) and PYS-2 parietal endodermal cells were also affected. The antiserum was also effective in preventing adhesion of trophoblasts to substratum. Furthermore, the antiserum caused rounding and detachment of the cells previously spread on the substrates, and the process could be reversed by removing the antiserum. Fab fragments isolated from the antiserum also inhibited cell-substratum adhesion, but not cell-cell adhesion, indicating that the factor involved is specific for cell-substratum adhesion. The antiserum inhibited adhesion of F9 and PYS-2 cells not only to plastic dishes but also to those coated with plasma fibronectin, laminin, and plant lectins such as concanavalin A (conA). Therefore, it is likely that the antiserum inhibited cell-substratum adhesion by blocking the function of an intrinsic component of cell-substratum adhesion rather than interfering with specific receptors for fibronectin or laminin. The glycoprotein with the antibody-blocking activity was partially purified from particulate fraction of teratocarcinoma OTT6050 by extraction with Triton X-100 and affinity chromatography on RCA-1-agarose and conA-agarose Upon Western blot analysis of the glycoprotein preparation, the antibody reacted only with a glycoprotein of the apparent molecular weight (MW), 125 000 (GP-125). An antibody preparation was isolated by affinity chromatography on Sepharose 4B coupled with the glycoprotein fraction and was shown to have all of the activities described above. Molecules resembling GP-125 could be also isolated from cultured F9 and PYS-2 cells by solubilization with Triton X-100 and indirect immunoprecipitation.
abstract_ja: 奇形癌OTT6050由来の糖タンパク質を、Ricinus communis agglutinin-1（RCA-1）によるアフィニティークロマトグラフィーで精製し、抗血清を作製した。この抗血清は、奇形癌細胞のプラスチック組織培養皿への接着と伸展を阻害した。胎児性癌細胞（F9およびN4-1）およびPYS-2壁側内胚葉細胞も影響を受けた。この抗血清は栄養膜細胞の基質への接着も阻害した。さらに、基質に接着し伸展した細胞を丸くさせて剥離させ、その作用は抗血清を除去すると可逆的であった。抗血清から単離したFab断片も、細胞と基質の接着を阻害したが、細胞同士の接着は阻害しなかった。このことから、関与する因子は基質接着に特異的であることが示された。抗体の阻害活性を持つ糖タンパク質は、OTT6050の粒子画分からTriton X-100による抽出と、RCA-1アガロースおよびconAアガロースによるアフィニティークロマトグラフィーで部分精製した。糖タンパク質標品のウエスタンブロット解析では、抗体は見かけの分子量125,000の糖タンパク質（GP-125）のみと反応した。GP-125に結合させたSepharose 4Bアフィニティークロマトグラフィーで抗体標品を単離したところ、上記の活性をすべて有していた。また、F9およびPYS-2培養細胞からも、Triton X-100による可溶化と間接免疫沈降により、GP-125様分子を単離できた。
